declared_at_utc: 2026-10-10T05:55Z (see commit), before any new February / June 2025 reading of nbr_state_v1, nbr_dark_v1 or oooi_pin_v1 and before the key_memory analogue screen
declared_by: Tier A only, Tier B waits for the user). Declaring and the readings are research; uploads stay the user's word.
purpose: The final file is ranked on January / July 2026, February / June 2026 and all four months. Every chain layer was declared on 2025 development months that exclude February and June. February / June 2025 are the analogues of the final's new months. This declaration fixes the rule that decides, per layer, whether it stays on for the final file's February 2026 and June 2026 rows. Survey and gaps: docs/final_file/febjun_check.md.

rule.default: Every layer of the accepted v76 chain stays on (the user's decision of 8 October 2026: full v76 chain, fill pins off).
rule.switch_off_february: A layer is switched off on the final file's February 2026 rows only if its February 2025 complete-month RMSE change is worse (> 0) AND its paired-day 95% interval of the RMSE difference lies entirely above zero.
rule.switch_off_june: The same for the final file's June 2026 rows with its June 2025 reading.
rule.unreadable: A layer without a February (June) 2025 reading stays on for February (June).
rule.no_tuning: No partial weights, no re-tuned thresholds, offsets or slopes, no airport choices; a switched-off layer passes its input through unchanged on that month's rows.
rule.tier_b: Readings on a later Tier B out-of-sample base (if the user approves one) replace the rows12 readings for the same layer under the same rule.

screen_not_governed.name: key_memory analogue, W24 2025
screen_not_governed.status: SCREEN ONLY. It switches nothing on or off; a positive result can only motivate a separate declaration for February 2026, with its own rule.
screen_not_governed.procedure: key_memory_v1's arithmetic on rows12 'stack' residuals: key = ADEP_mvt + FLIGHT_mvt (stripped, upper-cased; rows without a flight number get nothing); r = clip(label - stack, +-1800) on the memory month's non-fixed rows with label < 20,000 s; c = clip(0.25 x n / (n + 30) x mean r, +-120); new = max(stack + c, -12) on the target month's non-fixed rows with a key; complete-month RMSE change with the paired-day interval (seed 20261004).

pairs.analogue: January 2025 -> March 2025 (one month between, same IATA season W24, like November / December 2025 -> February 2026)

screen_not_governed.caveat: rows12 is a weaker base than the chain, so a flight-number memory will look stronger on it than on the chain.

disclosure: The eight readings under already_known_at_declaration were read and tabulated (docs/final_file/febjun_check.md, commit eac5281) before this rule was written; all are better on both months, so the rule switches none of them off. The rule's form (worse AND interval above zero) was proposed in that survey after seeing them. nbr_state_v1, nbr_dark_v1 and oooi_pin_v1 have never been read on February or June 2025 (their August-October fresh readings are known: all better). The key_memory analogue has never been computed. No official score is used.
